WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) as avg_ratio 
  FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
),
patient_stats AS (
  SELECT ID, 
         AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) as patient_avg_ratio, 
         AVG(PIC) as patient_avg_pic 
  FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 
  GROUP BY ID
),
above_avg_patients AS (
  SELECT ps.ID, ps.patient_avg_ratio, ps.patient_avg_pic
  FROM patient_stats ps 
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa 
  WHERE ps.patient_avg_ratio > oa.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(patient_avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(patient_avg_ratio) as mean_of_ratios,
  AVG(patient_avg_ratio) - (SELECT avg_ratio FROM overall_avg) as mean_excess
FROM above_avg_patients
